notes: Primary constructor sets up a default 2-point linear envelope: anIntArray2602 (values, fixed-point <<15 in advance/method1451) = [0, 65535], anIntArray2605 (normalized keyframe times, 0..65535) = [0, 65535] -- i.e. a straight ramp from 0 to full scale across the whole duration, used as the default before/unless deserialize/method1452 loads real envelope data.

Per-step envelope evaluator, confirmed by its usage throughout SynthSoundGenerator.kt (a software synthesizer): called once per output sample/step as `envelopeInterpolator.method1451(i)` where `i` is shared across many envelope instances in the same scope, consistent with a per-note total sample-count/duration parameter used to convert the normalized (0..65535) keyframe times in anIntArray2605 into absolute step counts (`anInt2610 = anIntArray2605[cursor] / 65536.0 * durationSamples`). Advances an internal linear-interpolation state machine: when the current step counter (anInt2609) reaches the next keyframe boundary (anInt2610), it recomputes the per-step delta (anInt2608) needed to ramp from the current fixed-point value to the next keyframe's value (anIntArray2602[cursor] shl 15) over the remaining steps, then always adds that delta to the running accumulator (anInt2612) and returns the pre-increment value shr 15 (converting back out of fixed point). This is a classic ADSR/keyframe envelope generator step function.

Reads 3 top-level envelope properties from the buffer: anInt2603 (a shape/category byte -- consumed elsewhere in SynthSoundGenerator.kt as a blend-amount parameter to method806, exact meaning e.g. 'curve type' vs 'modulation depth' not confirmed), anInt2607 and anInt2606 (two full Ints; used together in SynthSoundGenerator.kt as `(anInt2606-anInt2607)` for a 'range' and `anInt2607` alone for a 'base/sustain level', both scaled by a sample-rate-derived constant -- consistent with peak-level/base-level envelope-scaling parameters), then delegates to deserializeKeyframes/method1454 to read the actual keyframe table.

Resets all playback-cursor state (anInt2610, anInt2611, anInt2608, anInt2612, anInt2609) back to 0, restarting the envelope from its first keyframe. Called from SynthSoundGenerator.kt immediately before each new note-on / voice-restart sequence, always paired with a following series of advance/method1451 calls.

Reads the keyframe count into anInt2604, reallocates anIntArray2605 (times) and anIntArray2602 (values) to that size, then reads that many (time, value) unsigned-short pairs. Called both from deserialize/method1452 (initial load) and directly from FormantSynthFilter.kt (`envelopeInterpolator.method1454(buffer)`) to re-read just the keyframe table for a related/paired envelope, without re-reading the shape/level header fields.
